SELECT E.EXECUTION_ID, E.QUERY_ID, E.BATCH_ID, E.STATUS, E.STARTED_AT, E.DURATION_MS, B.REQUESTED_AT, R.REQUEST_ID, R.REQUEST_NO, R.TITLE AS REQUEST_TITLE, R.DEPT_ID, D.DEPT_NAME, U.USER_NAME AS DRAFTER_NAME, I.QUERY_TITLE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY E.QUERY_ID ORDER BY E.EXECUTION_ID DESC ) AS LATEST_RANK FROM QUERY_EXECUTION E JOIN QUERY_ITEM I ON I.QUERY_ID = E.QUERY_ID JOIN QUERY_REQUEST R ON R.REQUEST_ID = I.REQUEST_ID LEFT JOIN DEPARTMENT D ON D.DEPT_ID = R.DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_ID = R.DRAFTER_ID LEFT JOIN EXECUTION_BATCH B ON B.BATCH_ID = E.BATCH_ID AND B.REQUEST_ID = R.REQUEST_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND ( E.BATCH_ID IS NULL OR B.BATCH_ID IS NOT NULL )

SELECT E.EXECUTION_ID, E.BATCH_ID, E.QUERY_ID, R.REQUEST_ID, R.REQUEST_NO, R.TITLE AS REQUEST_TITLE, R.PURPOSE AS REQUEST_PURPOSE, DRAFTER.USER_NAME AS REQUESTER_NAME, EXECUTOR.USER_NAME AS EXECUTOR_NAME, I.QUERY_TITLE, I.SQL_TEXT, E.ATTEMPT_NO, E.STATUS, B.REQUESTED_AT, E.STARTED_AT, E.FINISHED_AT, E.DURATION_MS, E.ERROR_CODE, E.ERROR_MESSAGE, F.RESULT_ID, F.ROW_COUNT, F.FILE_SIZE, F.EXPIRES_AT, F.DELETED_AT FROM QUERY_EXECUTION E JOIN QUERY_ITEM I ON I.QUERY_ID = E.QUERY_ID JOIN QUERY_REQUEST R ON R.REQUEST_ID = I.REQUEST_ID LEFT JOIN USERS DRAFTER ON DRAFTER.USER_ID = R.DRAFTER_ID LEFT JOIN USERS EXECUTOR ON EXECUTOR.USER_ID = E.EXECUTED_BY LEFT JOIN EXECUTION_BATCH B ON B.BATCH_ID = E.BATCH_ID AND B.REQUEST_ID = R.REQUEST_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT RESULT_ID, EXECUTION_ID, ROW_COUNT, FILE_SIZE, EXPIRES_AT, DELETED_AT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY EXECUTION_ID ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC, RESULT_ID DESC ) AS RESULT_RANK FROM QUERY_RESULT ) F ON F.EXECUTION_ID = E.EXECUTION_ID AND F.RESULT_RANK = 1 WHERE E.EXECUTION_ID = #{executionId} AND ( E.BATCH_ID IS NULL OR B.BATCH_ID IS NOT NULL )

SELECT E.EXECUTION_ID, E.QUERY_ID, E.STATUS, F.RESULT_ID, F.FILE_PATH, F.EXPIRES_AT, F.DELETED_AT FROM QUERY_EXECUTION E JOIN QUERY_ITEM I ON I.QUERY_ID = E.QUERY_ID JOIN QUERY_REQUEST R ON R.REQUEST_ID = I.REQUEST_ID LEFT JOIN EXECUTION_BATCH B ON B.BATCH_ID = E.BATCH_ID AND B.REQUEST_ID = R.REQUEST_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT RESULT_ID, EXECUTION_ID, FILE_PATH, EXPIRES_AT, DELETED_AT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY EXECUTION_ID ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC, RESULT_ID DESC ) AS RESULT_RANK FROM QUERY_RESULT ) F ON F.EXECUTION_ID = E.EXECUTION_ID AND F.RESULT_RANK = 1 WHERE E.EXECUTION_ID = #{executionId} AND ( E.BATCH_ID IS NULL OR B.BATCH_ID IS NOT NULL )
